headline: Financial authorities say Fed's rate hike to have limited market impact
summary: The US Federal Reserve raised its key rate for the first time in more than three years to combat inflation. Financial authorities expect the decision to have a limited impact on markets.
why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, bond yields, equity valuations and the dollar across global markets.
why_moved: The rate increase is the first in more than three years, aimed at inflation, which shifts expectations for US borrowing costs and bond yields.
